title: Disentangling Hate in Online Memes
benchmark_measurement: Detection of hateful content in memes, with a specific focus on disentangling target entities, including religious groups (e.g., Muslims, Catholics), to improve classification accuracy and explainability.
findings: The proposed model, DisMultiHate, effectively disentangles religious target entities (e.g., 'Muslim Woman', 'Catholics') in multimodal memes. This capability was demonstrated through case studies where the model could retrieve relevant memes for religious queries, thereby improving hateful content classification and providing contextual explanations for its predictions.
